Security Guard Arrested for Alleged Molestation in Hyderabad

A security guard has been arrested in Hyderabad in connection with the alleged molestation of a software engineer. The incident occurred in Gachibowli. The woman filed a complaint with the police, who registered a case and reviewed CCTV footage from the area.
